hooks.text: 每代掌门死后化为剑魂，后代进入剑冢继承功法、属性与神剑特质
hooks.excerpt: When each sect leader falls, their soul returns to the Sword Tomb in the back mountains. The next generation can enter the tomb to inherit the arts of their ancestors, gaining cross-generational stat bonuses and unique traits for their bonded divine sword.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 100多种死亡威胁逼玩家押上寿命，用生命换取修为和成仙机会
hooks.excerpt: More than 100 deaths await you: crushed by a passing immortal's aura, blown apart by an alchemy furnace, or simply claimed by old age. Here, every scrap of power comes with a cost. Do you dare gamble your lifespan for a shot at immortality?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 自由拼接剑柄与剑刃，再用八类灵根塑造神剑外观、性格和战斗风格
hooks.excerpt: By freely combining Hilt + Blade , you can forge a one-of-a-kind bonded divine sword. Different spiritual roots (Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Thunder, Ice, Wind) give the blade its own glow, aura, and visual effects. As your Sword Soul grows, your divine sword develops a distinct personality and combat style of its own.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
